speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) how many Family Service Centres (FSCs) currently have a headcount dedicated for community work; and (b) whether the Ministry can provide more funding to FSCs to hire additional headcount dedicated for such work.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Our position has not changed and Mr Louis Ng may wish to refer to our earlier reply.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I am asking what is the average number of social workers in FSCs who are focused on community work?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I ask this because they have provided feedback to me that FSCs and social workers really do want to focus on that, to go upstream, to solve and address some of the problems they are seeing downstream.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And the problem now is the lack of funding.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I think MSF only provides funding for one headcount per FSC who handles a very large area.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: The Member is specifically asking about community work.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: It refers to a method of social work intervention when the community setting is utilised to enhance individual and family social network support connections as well as to build capacity in local communities to respond to the needs of individuals and families.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, it is not just one headcount that the Member has mentioned.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: Mr Louis Ng, a short supplementary question please.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I understand all that and I agree with the Minister of State that we are doing quite a number of things for FSCs.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: But the short question really is can MSF just look into this and find out how many social workers are focusing on community work in FSCs?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: And then at least we can see the results of that and change our policies.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I think there is no doubt that we want to help and assist and support our FSCs as much as possible.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: His question has been phrased with regard to community work but community work cannot exist in silo.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: We are working with individuals and families at the end of the day, and it depends on what level of interventions are needed.
